results.title: South African court sets limits on anti-migrant marches
results.content: Under the revised terms, the group may march between 9am and 3pm, with participants barred from carrying weapons or covering their faces. The group was also prohibited from destroying property or setting fire to buildings

results.title: Drone strikes in Ethiopia kill at least 25: witnesses
results.content: Multiple drone strikes have hit northern regions of Ethiopia since Thursday, killing at least 25 civilians, including children, witnesses and a medical source said on Friday

results.title: Ghana in talks with Russia for first nuclear power plant
results.content: Russian President Vladimir Putin met his Ghanaian counterpart John Dramani Mahama for bilateral talks the next day after Russia-Africa summit in Moscow

results.title: President Ruto seeks compensation for Kenyans recruited into Russian military
results.content: An investigation by Journalists for Justice, published earlier this month, identified at least 76 Kenyans killed while fighting for Russia, alongside 841 Kenyan nationals recruited between October 2022 and June 2026.

results.title: Tanzania still haunted by deadly election violence one year on
results.content: One year after Tanzania’s disputed election, the scars of deadly violence remain. Critics still live in fear of abductions and arrests, while opposition supporters continue to face intimidation.

results.title: Lagos Fashion Week returns for 15th edition with a commitment to sustainability
results.content: Lagos fashion week is back - returning this week for its 15th edition. This year's event is focused on circularity and sustainability - and ensuring African creators reap the benefits of their work.

results.title: Egyptian Red Crescent sends flour and winter supplies to Gaza
results.content: Egypt has sent an aid convoy of 62 trucks carrying more than 780 tonnes of relief supplies to Gaza, ahead of the winter season.

results.title: Gunfire heard across Ethiopia border as growing numbers flee into Kenya
results.content: Gunfire echoes across the Ethiopia-Kenya border in Moyale, as violence drives thousands to flee into Kenya. The clashes stem from a territorial dispute between Ethiopia’s Oromia and Somali regions.

results.title: Pakistan: Islamabad zoo introduces 'Coffee with Alpaca' attraction
results.content: Coffee with a side of alpacas? At a zoo near Islamabad, visitors can enjoy drinks and snacks while watching, feeding and petting the animals. The attraction features ten imported alpacas, a first for Pakistan according to the zoo.

results.title: Poor services and crime fuel voter frustration ahead of South Africa’s polls
results.content: South Africans head to the polls next week, with basic services, crime and unemployment among the key issues shaping the local elections.

results.title: First body recovered from Nairobi building collapse as 16 remain missing
results.content: A first body was recovered Friday from the rubble of an 18-storey building that collapsed a week ago in Nairobi, as 16 people remain missing.

results.title: Ghanaian teenager, 15, shot dead near New York school
results.content: A 15-year-old boy originally from Ghana has died after being shot near his school in New York City, as police search for three teenagers in connection with the killing.

results.title: Czech Republic: Meerkats and cheetah cubs play with Halloween pumpkins
results.content: Halloween has arrived at Prague Zoo, where meerkats are exploring pumpkins stuffed with worms and cheetah cubs are discovering seasonal toys. Four days of activities will bring treats to 14 animal species.

results.title: Italy: Thousands protest rising living costs and defence spending in general strike
results.content: Thousands of protesters marched through Rome, Italy, on Friday, 30 October, during a general strike called by the left-wing Unione Sindacale di Base (USB) trade union.

results.title: Fuel shortages push Malawians into endless queues and rising costs
results.content: Fuel shortages and soaring petrol prices are putting daily life and businesses under severe pressure in Malawi. In the capital, Lilongwe, drivers and motorcycle taxi operators are spending hours, and sometimes days, in queues as they wait for scarce supplies.

results.title: Senegal gears up for a historic Dakar 2026 Youth Olympics
results.content: IOC President Kirsty Coventry has toured the Youth Olympic Village in Dakar, just two days before the start of the 2026 Youth Olympic Games.

results.title: France and Chad resume military cooperation as they mend ties
results.content: The French army says two fighter jets and a transport aircraft will soon make a stopover in Chad where they will carry out "training activities".

results.title: Indonesia: nine orangutans rescued from wildfires return to the forest
results.content: Nine orangutans rescued from devastating wildfires in Indonesian Borneo have returned to the forest after weeks of rehabilitation. Among them are four mothers with their young, including three females expecting another baby.

results.title: King Charles’ visit to Guyana reignites calls for a British apology and reparations for slavery
results.content: King Charles the Third’s visit to Guyana is bringing renewed attention to Britain’s colonial past and growing calls for an apology over slavery.

results.title: US: flowers laid at Patrick Stewart's Hollywood star after his death
results.content: Flowers have been placed at Patrick Stewart's Hollywood Walk of Fame star following reports of the British actor's death at 86. Visitors gather in Los Angeles to remember his celebrated screen roles.

results.title: French publisher returns to Algiers book fair after two-year ban
results.content: Gallimard has been caught in legal battles over accusations that French-Algerian writer, Kamel Daoud, plagiarised a women's life in his novel 'Houris'.

results.title: Africa Cup of Nations to maintain 2-year cycle after CAF U-turn
results.content: The Africa Cup of Nations will maintain its two-year cycle after a U-turn from the Confederation of African Football. Earlier this month, CAF announced the Africa Nations League as a new biennial competition. It said AFCON would move to a four-year cycle.

results.title: US: Trump hands out sweets as Air Force One soars overhead
results.content: Donald and Melania Trump welcomed children in Halloween costumes to the White House on Thursday. The couple handed out sweets, posed for photographs and watched Air Force One fly overhead.

results.title: South Africa selects Durban as preferred candidate for Olympic bid
results.content: The SA Sports Confederation and Olympic Committee says, however, it will likely be a "multi-city" bid that would propose some events are held in other cities.

results.title: Haiti announces new election dates as El Salvador sends troops to rescue missing soldiers
results.content: Haiti’s government has announced new election dates as the armed gangs who terrorize the country continue to fight against Haitian police and soldiers, who are now backed by the recent arrival of more than 2,000 troops from El Salvador.

results.title: Durban to lead South Africa’s bid to bring Olympics to Africa
results.content: South Africa has selected Durban to lead its bid for the 2036 or 2040 Summer Olympics, as the country seeks to become the first in Africa to host the Games.

results.title: Mexico: world's tallest Catrina unveiled for Día de Muertos in Mexico City
results.content: A 33.4-metre Catrina has broken a Guinness World Record in Mexico City. Towering over the Zócalo, the giant skeleton is surrounded by thousands of marigolds ahead of Day of the Dead celebrations.

results.title: Israel's final election results show no bloc has won a majority
results.content: As opposition politicians meet to explore options for a coalition, the PM has accused Arab-led parties of election fraud.
